messages:
Maia (CS): quick heads-up — noticing a partial failure in the bulk activation pipeline affecting EDU customers created between 2026-03-20 00:00–06:00 UTC. drafting comms; need technical status and ETA so we can segment outreach.
Omar (SRE): saw this at 02:14 UTC, indexer returned 502s, started rolling back the staging release at 02:22.
Aaron (Eng): rollback completed 02:34, activation worker restarted. root cause looks like a schema change in proto v2.4 that wasn't backwards compatible.
Sanjay (Ops): backfill started at 03:00 UTC, running at ~50 activations/sec — rough ETA ~5–7 hours for full catch-up.
Maia (CS): thanks. I'll split customers into: high-touch (enterprise / renewals within 90d) and bulk EDU. High-touch msg needs personalized note + SLA credit offer. Bulk can be an opt-in status email.
Lena (CS): agree. can someone confirm list of high-touch account IDs? I have a spreadsheet; will add notes with recommended credits based on usage tier.
Omar (SRE): pushing additional workers to raise throughput in 30m; will update ETA once we hit 120/sec.
Aaron (Eng): fix for proto deployed to canary — no additional failures on canary traffic. Planning a soft reprocess that skips the problematic field for older records.
Maia (CS): draft for mass email below — keep it short, empathetic, and include mitigation + next steps.
Maia (CS): ```
Hi <Customer>,

We're reaching out to let you know we experienced an activation delay affecting some accounts created on Mar 20 between 00:00–06:00 UTC. Our engineering team identified the issue and has restored activation processing; a backfill is in progress and should complete within ~6 hours.

What we're doing: running a prioritized backfill, offering a 10% service credit to affected EDU accounts, and scheduling live office hours today at 16:00 UTC if you'd like help.

No action is required from you. Reply or join the office hours if you'd like a status call.

— Maia, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
```
Aaron (Eng): wording looks fine. recommend removing specific ETA if ops may change; maybe say "expected within ~6 hours" — keep conservative.
Sanjay (Ops): updated throughput — 110/sec, ETA now 3–4 hours for full backlog.
Lena (CS): I'll prep personalized notes for five renewal-risk EDU accounts and ping their CSMs.
Maia (CS): who will send mass email? I'm happy to, but need final approval from legal on credit wording.
deploy-bot: scheduled: mass-email-draft 1 created by Maia (CS) — awaiting approval
Maia (CS): looping in @legal for credit blurb. Also scheduling office hours: zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/edu-activation-officehours
Omar (SRE): monitoring shows no new 502s. I'll post another update in 30m or when backfill finishes.
Lena (CS): thanks all. I'll compile the list of affected EDU accounts and mark priority ones. ping me if you need help drafting subject lines.
Maia (CS): final ask: CSMs for those priority accounts, please DM me the recommended concession amount (we'll keep within 20% cap unless escalated). planning to send mass note once legal OKs language.
Sanjay (Ops): backfill complete at 06:12 UTC. confirmed activations caught up. closing incident pipeline.
Maia (CS): sending final note to customers now. thanks everyone. :pray:
